description: This file implements a Bluetooth HCI packet forwarding utility for Android, handling communication between a virtual HCI device and a virtio console, including packet processing, raw terminal configuration, and event handling.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends data with a specific HCI packet type over a file descriptor, handling retries and errors.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Reads data from one file descriptor and writes it to another, ignoring vendor packets.

methods.name: setTerminalRaw
methods.description: Configures a terminal device to raw mode.
